newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Cadac launches 1 for 2 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Cadac launches 1 for 2 rights issue.

text.p: Cadac Ltd said on Wednesday it had resolved to proceed with a one-for-two rights issue at 10 NZ cents per share, with the aim of raising NZ$1.44 million.
Cadac, a technology company, is in the early stages of commercialising its brushless direct current motor.
Cadac Chairman Shawn Beck said the funds would be used as a buffer for existing operations, development and patenting.
The company was also exploring the possibility of forming a joint venture with Asian interests, he said.
If successful, the venture would run along similar lines to the agreement with Wellington Electric in the U.S., which is 40 percent owned by Cadac.
Cadac is 30 percent owned by Strathmore Group and 19 percent by the Greenstone Fund, a venture capital fund backed by the New Zealand Government and several leading institutions.
Cadac's shares trade on the unofficial "grey" market run by the New Zealand Stock Exchange.
